info.name: Laravel Product API - Complete Automated Tests
info.description: Run all 49 requests in order with 1 iteration and 0 ms delay. Wait 65 seconds after previous registration/login testing before starting. Allowlist 127.0.0.1 in Cookies > Domains Allowlist. Use No Environment and enable the cookie jar. The first request generates fresh emails. Creates two disposable test users; deletes only products created by this run. Users remain in the database. Existing users/products are not targeted. Every modifying request automatically reads the latest CSRF cookie, except intentional missing/invalid-token tests. On unexpected status, the Runner stops. Re-run from 01 with new users if interrupted. Verified locally against MySQL with 123 passing assertions. Demo passwords are disposable test fixtures, not application credentials.
